title: Our Team Listing
hero_desc: Our integrated team of neurologists, neurosurgeons, spine surgeons, and rehabilitation experts collaborates under the leadership of Dr. Praveen Gupta to provide world-class brain, spine, and nerve care.
section1_text: Led by Dr. Praveen Gupta, Chairman of Marengo Asia International Institute of Neuro & Spine, our team combines decades of specialized experience across stroke, epilepsy, movement disorders, and spine surgery.
